GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is said with the sound "eye"? (1 mark)
   A. Tier
   B. heute
   C. Schule
   D. nein

2. How is the letter B named in German? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. ay
   C. tsay
   D. bay

3. How is "s" pronounced before a vowel, as in "Sonne"? (1 mark)
   A. like ts
   B. like sh
   C. like z
   D. like k

4. What does "Sie ist alt, aber sehr nett" mean? (1 mark)
   A. She is young and funny
   B. She is old and unkind
   C. She is tall and strong
   D. She is old but very kind

5. What does "der Opa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. father
   B. grandfather
   C. family
   D. sister

6. What does "hinter dem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. next to the house
   B. behind the house
   C. on the house
   D. in front of the house

7. What does "die Tür" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. plate
   B. pot
   C. door
   D. kitchen

8. Which two words is "Wochenende" made from? (1 mark)
   A. Woche and Ende
   B. Wochen and Tag
   C. Tag and Ende
   D. Woche and Tag

9. Which German word means "today"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. jetzt
   C. morgen
   D. gestern

10. What is the plural of "das Lied"? (1 mark)
   A. die Lieder
   B. die Lieden
   C. die Lieds
   D. die Liede

11. Which German word is the number 2? (1 mark)
   A. neunzehn
   B. zwei
   C. achtzehn
   D. drei

12. What does "denn" mean in "Ich mag keine Cola, denn Cola ist nicht gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. because
   B. and
   C. then
   D. but

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

14. What is the plural of "der Zeh"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zehs
   B. die Zehen
   C. die Zehe
   D. die Zehner

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Zahn"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. die
   D. den

16. What does "die Hand" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. shoulder
   B. leg
   C. hand
   D. finger

17. What does "der Nebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloud
   B. sky
   C. fog
   D. thunderstorm

18. What does "der Wind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. wind
   C. rain
   D. rainbow

19. What does "tanzen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to dance
   B. to eat
   C. to have a shower
   D. to sing

20. What does "schlafen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sleep
   B. to see
   C. to eat
   D. to speak

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each. (3 marks)

22. Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is. (2 marks)

23. Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20. (3 marks)

24. Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow. (4 marks)

25. Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana. (4 marks)

26. Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means. (2 marks)

27. Write the four punctuation marks with their German names. (4 marks)

28. Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example. (2 marks)

29. Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase. (3 marks)

30. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — nein
   The letters ei sound like the English word eye.

2. D — bay
   In German the letter B is called bay.

3. C — like z
   S before a vowel sounds like z.

4. D — She is old but very kind
   alt = old, aber = but, sehr nett = very kind.

5. B — grandfather
   der Opa means grandfather.

6. B — behind the house
   hinter means behind.

7. C — door
   die Tür means door.

8. A — Woche and Ende
   Woche = week and Ende = end, so weekend.

9. A — heute
   today in German is heute.

10. A — die Lieder
   The plural of das Lied is die Lieder.

11. B — zwei
   2 in German is zwei.

12. A — because
   denn gives a reason.

13. D — das
   It is das Brot, so the little word is das.

14. B — die Zehen
   The plural of der Zeh is die Zehen.

15. B — der
   It is der Zahn, so the little word is der.

16. C — hand
   die Hand means hand.

17. C — fog
   der Nebel means fog.

18. B — wind
   der Wind means wind.

19. A — to dance
   tanzen means to dance.

20. A — to sleep
   schlafen means to sleep.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
